Sandy canvas, indigo and warm apricot

Sign in to organise your clothes, build outfits and plan what to buy.
Use your email and a password. No code to enter.
We will send a password reset link to your email.
If this email has an account, you will receive a reset link. Check your spam folder too. Set a new password using the link, then return here to sign in.
Enter a full email address, such as name@example.com.
This password does not meet the service requirements. Use at least 12 characters and try a different password.
Could not sign in. Check your email and password, or reset your password.
Could not create an account. Try signing in or resetting your password.
Could not connect. Check your internet connection and try again.
Too many attempts. Please wait and try again later.
Sign-in is currently unavailable. Please try again later.
Sign-in is not connected in this build. The app needs its service configuration.
Request cancelled. Waiting for it to finish before another attempt. Any email already sent or account already created cannot be undone by cancelling.
Preparing your data on this phone.
This phone has items from the previous version. Link them to %1$s? Only this account will access them. If they are not yours, start empty: the old data will stay unassigned.
Check the available space on your phone and try again. Existing data has not been deleted.
Your session has ended. Sign in to the same account to continue where you left off.
Use the same account, or choose Switch account.
Drafts stay on this device and return after signing in to the same account. Saved items remain with their account.
Your items will remain on this phone. Sign in to the same account to open them again.
Data is stored on your phone. You can enable cloud sync in settings after signing in.
Choose your mood. Changes apply immediately and are saved on this device.
Appearance could not be saved. Your current choice works until the app closes. Try again.
Save something you like or a piece your wardrobe is missing.
Move the two range sliders below the photo to adjust the frame. Darkened areas will be cropped. Rotating resets the frame to the whole photo.
Apply the edit, then select Save in the item form. The previous photo will be replaced without keeping an original.
Crop frame; shaded areas will be removed
Changes are saved, but some old photo files could not be removed. Cleanup will retry on the next launch.
Suggestions can be wrong. Check the category, colour and item edges before applying.
Could not identify the category. Choose it manually.
Background separated. Check that the whole item remains in the photo.
Background removal needs a one-time tool download. You can also save the current background.
Background removal requires available, up-to-date Google Play services. You can keep the photo and fill in the fields manually.
Could not separate the item from its background. Try another photo or crop this one.
Could not remove the background. Retry, or crop the photo and keep its background.
You can correct the fields manually. To keep changes, select Save at the bottom of the item form.

Google ML Kit analyses the photo on your phone; the image is not uploaded for recognition. Only the current photo is kept. Google Play services downloads the background removal model, which requires internet access. The SDK may send technical performance metrics to Google. This is a general model: it may miss clothing, include the person wearing it, or misidentify colours under different lighting. Recognition suggests tops, bottoms or shoes; jackets and other pieces can be selected manually.
The model may still be downloading. Keep your connection on and select Analyse photo again in a minute.
Could not prepare the model. Check your connection and Google Play services, then retry.
Add a photo, a name and choose an item category.
Open a wardrobe and check its contents before deleting it. You can rename matching names.
Items: %1$d, including %2$d archived. Outfits: %3$d. Shopping entries: %4$d.
This deletes this wardrobe, its items (including archived items), photos, outfits, wear history and shopping list. Other wardrobes remain. Recovery requires a saved ZIP backup.
I confirm deletion of this wardrobe and its contents
Keep at least one wardrobe. Create another before deleting this one.
Wardrobe deleted, but some unused photo files could not be removed from phone storage.
Add a photo and an item name.
Add your first item with a photo.
Photos and history stay saved. This item will be excluded from new suggestions.
Some matching pieces are missing. Add tops, bottoms or shoes and check season and availability.
Suggested using category, season, style and colour. This is a basic recommendation.
Records wear for every item in the outfit.
No outfits yet. Open an item and select Build an outfit.
What would you like to buy?

Data and drafts are stored on your phone. Cloud sync transfers saved clothes, photos, shopping history, outfits, calendar and travel lists between devices of this account. Drafts stay on their device. Backups remain available separately.
The ZIP contains all wardrobes and current photos without originals. Keep it in your own storage. Restore adds separate wardrobes without overwriting existing ones.
Wardrobes restored. Select them from the list.
Check free space and file access. Photos: up to 25 MB; backups: up to 20 GB unpacked. Try again.
For now, choose category and colour manually.
Add a few items to build your first outfit. Start with any category.
For your first outfit, add a top, bottom and shoes, or a dress or jumpsuit with shoes.
No pieces are in the wash.
No active pieces. Check the archive or add a piece.
Changes are stored as a local draft. Discarding deletes this draft; saved records stay unchanged.
The status has changed again. Open the piece and check its availability.
Things you like and what is missing.
Save a product or describe a need. Photo and link are optional.
Have you found a specific product or are you still looking?
Could not open the link. It remains saved.
Add the product you found. The original need, requirements and budget will be kept.
Save a name and category. Price and other details are optional.
Describe what is missing. Add a product to this need when you find one.
Enter a complete http:// or https:// link.
Enter a non-negative amount with up to two decimal places.
Could not store the draft. Stay on this form and try saving again.
What is the occasion and weather?
Choose manually — no location access needed.
Where should the pieces come from?
Owned clothes and saved wishes with ownership labels.
Example ideas. These pieces are not in your wardrobe.
Pieces outside this source and their locks were removed.
Tap a piece to lock it, replace it or see details.
Unlock this piece before replacing it.
Choose a category to add or replace a piece.
No available pieces. Change the source or add clothes to your wardrobe.
This is an example of combining basic pieces. Save it as an idea and adapt it to your wardrobe.
Occasion prioritises style and weather filters season. Locked pieces stay in place.
A piece is no longer available. Remove or replace it before saving.
You can save a partial outfit and complete it later.
Create your first outfit using settings or manual selection.
Wear logging is available only for owned and available pieces.
The photo is ready but the item type was not identified. Choose a category manually. Your entries have been kept.
The draft photo is saved. Continue without processing or run recognition below.
Unfinished changes remain on this device. Sign in to the same account to continue.
New sign-in and reauthentication need a connection. Local drafts return after signing in to the same account.
Draft restored — continue where you left off.
This purchase has already moved or its source is no longer available. Return to the list.
Review the details and confirm that you own this item. Keep the saved photo or add your own. The price, link and original need will be retained.
The item has been edited or worn. The move back to the wish list was stopped to preserve those changes.
Offline. Changes are saved on this device.
Preparing photo. You can keep filling in the details.
Background removed. Check the item edges; crop or rotate the photo if needed.
Choose up to 20 photos. We process them in order; review each item before saving. The queue stays on this device.
Ready to review: %1$d. Remaining in queue: %2$d.
The queue is empty. Saved items are in your wardrobe.
Could not open the photo. Retry or skip it.
This removes the unsaved item and its temporary photos from the queue.
This draft was already saved or skipped. Return to the queue.
Up to three looks from your available items. Check weather and occasion, then replace any piece.
Available items from compatible seasons. Weather: %1$s. Style preference for: %2$s.
This look includes an item with no recorded wears. Give it a try.
No other available item fits this piece. Check laundry, season or try another look.
No complete outfit fits the current conditions. Check availability, seasons, selected items and repeat-wear rules.
Check that shoes and outerwear resist rain; the catalog does not record these properties.
Enter a city and select it from the list. The query is sent to Open-Meteo; location permission is not needed.
City not found. Add the country name.
No forecast for this date. Choose weather manually.
Could not update weather. The previous forecast is shown if available; you can choose weather manually.
Plan the week ahead. Wear counts change only after confirming “Wore it”.
No looks planned for this day.
Before wearing, replace missing items or return them from laundry, repair or archive.
Remove this plan from the calendar?
We count recorded wear days per item. Plans are excluded; several marks on one day count once. Prices are optional and currencies are kept separate.
Recorded value: %1$s · items with a price: %2$d
Without a price: %1$d. Add it in item details.
No data for this view yet.
Cost per wear unknown: no price
Cost per wear appears after the first wear
Build a look with this item
Collect looks for a season or trip. Get a list of your items without duplicates and check what is packed.
No capsules yet. Start with saved looks.
Unavailable items: %1$d. Check them before the trip.
An item shared by several looks appears once. Editing a look updates this list.
This look now includes an unpurchased item. It is excluded from the packing list.
Choose looks or add your own items manually.
First save a look made of your own items.
Clear all packed checks? Items and looks remain.
Delete this capsule? Items and saved looks remain in the wardrobe.
Choose both dates. End must be on or after start.
Try the product with available items in your wardrobe to assess the purchase before paying.
The product is assumed to suit all seasons; check material, fit and occasion yourself. Matching uses category and color.
New options found: %1$d · already saved: %2$d (up to 20 checked)
Already owned in this category and color
No matches in this color and category.
Add the product color to check similar items.
Available items are missing for a complete look. Change weather or add to the wardrobe.
The product stays on the shopping list. It can be marked as worn after purchase.
The last attempt failed. Previous copies are preserved. Check folder access and try again.
Time to make a fresh wardrobe backup.

Daily backups use your chosen folder for the current account. The first copy starts after enabling. Android may delay later copies because of battery or storage conditions. Choose a private folder: the ZIP contains your photos and data. Unsaved drafts are not included.
Wardrobes: %1$d Items: %2$d Outfits: %3$d Your current wardrobe is unchanged.
Photos added to the queue: %1$d. Photograph the next item or review the queue.
Select entries and choose the fields to apply. Other details and photos are kept.
The same photo is already used for “%1$s”. Check whether this is a different item.
Drag to erase the background. Restore brings back areas erased in this edit. To correct an automatic cutout, start from the photo with its background.
Apply this edit and reopen the photo to continue.
Start with a top and bottom, a dress or a jumpsuit. Add shoes, layers and accessories. An outfit can contain up to 12 items.
Unlock the pieces that need to be replaced first.
Only available items in this capsule are used. Saved outfits are automatically added to it.
Skip items worn in the last day
Skip items worn in the last 3 days
Skip items worn in the last 7 days
Skip items worn in the last 14 days
Skip items worn in the last 30 days
Only confirmed wear counts. Calendar plans do not exclude items. Shorten the period if you need more choices.
You can still add this item manually.
Select an item. Drag it or resize with two fingers. You can also use the buttons below.
This entry is no longer available. Return to the previous screen to update your selection.
“%1$s” already contains these pieces. Open it, or explicitly update its name, conditions and composition with your current changes.
There are no items in this wardrobe yet.
This capsule has no items yet.
The packed items cannot form an outfit under these conditions yet.
The basic pieces exist, but some are currently unavailable to wear.
There are no available shoes in this selection.
Add a dress or jumpsuit, or a top and bottom.
There are not enough compatible items for this weather. Cold, cool and rainy conditions also need outerwear.
The available items cannot currently form a season-compatible outfit.
The pinned items constrain this search. An option exists without the pins.
The repeat-wear rule removed items needed for this search.
Items excluded from recommendations are needed for this option.
The available options are hidden by previous feedback.
Several constraints may apply together. Review weather, seasons, repeats, exclusions and pins. Conditions are never relaxed automatically.
These pieces are already saved. Opening the existing outfit with its name.
Tap an item for replacement, pinning or details. Open Composition to move it.
Reset all item positions? You can undo this with Undo last change.
Defer this photo? Unsaved form changes will be discarded. The photo remains in the review queue.
No more ready photos in this review. Deferred, failed and processing photos remain in the queue.
Copy only selected fields from “%1$s”. They will replace the current values.
Drag a frame corner. You can also set precise bounds with the controls below.
Pan the enlarged photo or pinch to zoom. This mode does not draw the mask.
Draw with the brush. The circle shows its size on the photo. Enable the separate mode to pan.
Showing the actual pieces worn that day. The saved outfit has changed since then.
Operation cancelled. Saved items are unchanged.
Backup cancelled. The partial file could not be removed; delete it in the selected folder. No successful backup was recorded.
Adding cancelled. Photos already queued remain available for review.
Could not open local wardrobe data. Try again.
Could not finish saving. Check the fields and availability of selected items. Your form entries are retained.
The device is out of storage. Free some space and retry.
The file is no longer accessible. Select it again or grant access in the system picker.
The backup folder cannot be read or written. Choose an accessible folder and enable automatic backups again.
Could not prepare the photo. Check that it is readable and at most 25 MB. The previous photo and fields are retained.
The ZIP is damaged or is not a supported Wardrobe backup. Choose another file. Existing wardrobes are not replaced.
Could not read the entire backup. Check access and select the file again.
The selected file changed after verification. Verify it again before restoring.
Could not create and verify the backup. Check free space and write access. This attempt is not marked successful.
The destination for the new ZIP is no longer accessible. Choose another backup destination.
Capsule membership or packing changed. Refresh recommendations to use the current items.
The initial automatic backup is waiting for Android to start it.
The automatic backup is waiting for dependent work.
Daily backup is scheduled. Android determines when it runs.
There is no active scheduled work. Toggle automatic backups off and on to schedule again.
Choose a folder first, then enable daily backup.
Data from this verified ZIP will be added as separate wardrobes. Current items, outfits and wear records remain in place.
Purchase undone. The item is back on your wishlist.
This purchase cannot be safely undone. The history and item have been kept.
Enable on each device to use the same wardrobe. Offline changes will wait for a connection.
Automatic replacement is paused. Choose what to keep. Keeping both adds the cloud wardrobes separately.
Finish or discard the unsaved draft and photo queue before downloading another wardrobe.
Cloud storage for this app is not connected yet or access is denied. Your changes are saved on this phone.
Cloud data could not be verified or exceeds the supported size. Local data is safe.
Sync could not finish. Changes are saved; we will retry when the connection recovers.
Saved changes are waiting to sync.
The cloud wardrobe will be replaced by this device’s data. Other devices will receive this version when they sync.
Local data will be replaced by the cloud wardrobe. A backup of the current version will be saved first and can be restored in settings.
This device’s data will stay. Cloud wardrobes will be added separately, marked “Restored”. Shared items may appear twice; both versions will then sync.
Data changed while you were choosing. Sync again and review the current versions.
Restore the backup made before replacement
Choice applied. Changes are waiting for sync verification.
The item will return to the wishlist. Purchase history and saved outfit contents will be kept.
This older purchase has no record needed for a safe undo.
The item has been edited. Undo will not delete your later changes.
Wear has been recorded. Undo those wear records first.
The item belongs to a capsule or packing list. Remove it there first.
The changed outfit cannot safely restore the wished item. Edit that outfit first.
This item is in the laundry.
The original need, requirements and budget will return. This product’s photo, link and price will remain in history.
Original need restored. The product remains in history.
Add a product link. Review the photo, name and price: shop information may be incomplete or out of date.
Could not get shop details or the photo. Retry, or close this message and enter the details manually.
If the shop provides no details, continue to the editor and enter them manually. Automatic loading supports public HTTPS pages.
Unnamed product — review in the editor
The exact price and currency are unknown. Enter them in the editor if needed.
This link is already saved. Review the match before adding another item.
An item with this link already exists. Continue adding another record?
The match is in the selected wardrobe. Finish the import and open that wardrobe to review it.
Nothing is added to your collection until you tap Save in the editor.
Could not receive the link. The queue may be full or the content unsupported. Copy the link and add it through the add menu.
Finish the current draft first. The link stays in the queue.
Links waiting: %1$d. Finish the current edit first.
Choose a saved product that you have not bought yet.
The price exceeds the budget by %1$s.
The entered price is within the budget.
Price and budget use different currencies. No currency conversion is applied.
We compare recorded traits and your items in this wardrobe. Check material, fit and size yourself.
The product season is unknown: these examples do not confirm suitability for the weather.
The colour is unknown. Colour coordination cannot be confirmed.
Missing traits are not guessed. These fields apply to this review without changing the product; when buying, review them in the item editor.
The product remains in your shopping list.
Examples: %1$d · saved: %2$d · owned items in examples: %3$d
Up to 20 examples are shown, not every possible combination. An unsaved outfit alone does not mean a new capability.
Examples with no owned replacement found: %1$d.
Could not prepare the comparison. The product is saved; retry or decide later.
No matches were found using the available traits. This does not guarantee that you have no similar item.
This compares traits, not product identity from photos. Each item shows its matching reasons; archived items are included.
Excluded from the current automatic suggestions.
The specified product season does not match the weather context. Check the season or change the weather filter.
No complete outfit was found under the current conditions. Check available items, seasons and suggestion settings.
Unavailable items in this wardrobe: %1$d (archived, laundry, repair or lent).
Available items outside current suggestions: %1$d. Check exclusions and the interval between repeated wears.
A possible replacement is available in your wardrobe.
You own a possible replacement, but it is currently unavailable.
No owned replacement was found for this example under the current rules.
A replacement keeps the category and season compatibility with the other pieces. Colour, style and fit may differ. Manually chosen replacements may be excluded from automatic suggestions.
This version uses only your own items. The product remains in your shopping list.
Photo access was denied. Select it from the gallery again or take a new photo.
The photo file is unavailable. Choose another photo, or download it to your phone and select it again.
The image could not be decoded. It may be damaged or use an unsupported format. Choose another photo or a JPG/PNG copy.
The photo exceeds the 25 MB limit. Choose a smaller copy.
The photo could not be read or written. Retry or choose another file; check the available space on your phone.
Processing did not finish; the exact cause is unknown. Retry or fill in the details manually if the photo displays correctly.
Photo processing timed out. Retry or keep the current photo and fill in the details manually.
Automatic item recognition did not finish. Choose a category manually; processing again is optional.
The item type was not recognized. Choose a category manually and save the current photo.
Keep photo and enter details manually
Details of the previous processing are unavailable. Enter the details manually or analyse the photo again.
Add a usable gallery or camera photo to save this item.
Choose a category to save. Tap Save to go to the field.
Pinch to zoom, drag to move. Double-tap to zoom in or fit the photo.
Photos use a white background, or cream for white items. You can correct the item colour below.

Automatic cleanup is gentle: it preserves more fabric but may leave some background. Use stronger cleanup when needed and check fine details. If a saved photo has already lost detail, replace it with the original.
One tap or stroke is one step. Redo restores an undone step; a new stroke clears redo. Switching to crop or rotate applies these edits and starts a new history.
Undo and Redo cover cropping and rotation. Switching to background applies these edits and starts a new history.
Use 1–4 px for fine details and a larger brush for wide areas. Size is in photo pixels. Zoom in for precision.
Undo and Redo cover every stroke, crop and rotation until you finish editing.
Could not preview these edits. Undo the last step or try again.
Release a corner or slider to apply the crop. Use Undo to restore it.
The magnifier shows the area under your finger at 3×. Near an edge, it moves to stay visible.
0% softness gives a hard edge; 100% gives a gradual edge. Strength controls how much one stroke erases or restores. Repeat a stroke for a stronger effect.
Tap a visible piece of background. Only the connected area of similar colour is highlighted. Adjust tolerance and check the edges: a similarly coloured garment can also be selected.
Could not select the area. Retry or use the brush.
This area is already transparent. Tap a visible piece of background.
All visible pixels are selected. Lower the tolerance or use the brush.
Selected: %1$d px. Check the highlighted area.
Confirm removal or clear the selection before applying the photo. Undo can restore the removed area.
The left side shows the photo before manual cleanup; the right shows the result. Move the slider; crop and rotation match on both sides.
This background only helps reveal residue and light edges. Garment colours and saved photo transparency stay unchanged.
Review each result and approve its replacement. Processing uses the saved photo and cannot recover previously removed detail. Other item details stay unchanged.
Cutout photo: up to %1$d × %1$d px, depending on the source and device memory. Small photos are not artificially enlarged.
The queue could not be read. Saved photos are unchanged. Cancel the queue and select the photos again.
Queue complete. Select more photos in the catalog.
Stop processing after the current operation
The photo or item changed after it was queued. Replacement is blocked. Skip it and select the item again.
Unapproved results will be removed. Replacements you already saved will remain.
Reprocessing failed. The previous result is still available for review.
The queue state could not be saved. Reopen the app to recover processing.
Select up to 500 photos for one queue.
Shrink edges to remove a background fringe, or soften them. Expansion can only restore content available in this session source. Zoom in to inspect thin details.
Tap around the outline to add at least 3 points. The polygon closes automatically. Inspect the area and confirm the action.
Preview of edges, lasso and protected areas
No available changes. Check the outline, protected areas or available source pixels.
This is a preview. Apply the step or clear the selection to continue.
Cyan marks protected areas. Brush, background selection, lasso and edge edits leave them unchanged. Cropping and source reset affect the whole photo.
Photo edits are unfinished. Resume editing and apply or discard them before saving the item.
Confirmed steps and Undo/Redo are saved in the draft.
Photo history could not be restored. The photo is safe. Return to the form or discard the damaged history.
Choose the type this category belongs to so outfit suggestions can use it correctly.
This category already exists. Select it from the list.
No subcategories yet. Add them when editing your items.
A colour with this name already exists.
Choose the closest basic colour to help match outfits.
The copy contains only the selected wardrobe: items, photos, outfits and history. It does not replace a full backup.
Choose a wardrobe to back up
The selected wardrobe was saved and verified.
A server copy of one wardrobe. Local data is retained. Invitations and ongoing family sync are not available yet.
Create a server copy of this wardrobe with items, outfits, history and final photos? Other wardrobes are excluded. Local data stays on this device.
Initial snapshot confirmed by the server
Verify your email using the email link, then retry.
Email sent. After verifying your email, retry the transfer.
Access could not be verified. Check your account and sign-in, then retry. Local data is safe.
The family server is not configured or is incompatible with this version. A server update is required.
The server has a different version. Transfer stopped without overwriting it; the versions need reconciliation.
The attempt expired. Retry to check the server and renew the upload.
Local data changed. Use “Prepare again” to transfer current data.
The server confirmed the earlier snapshot, but local data has changed. New edits have not been synced; they remain on this device.
The archive or transfer record is damaged, missing or too large. Check photos; an unfinished transfer can be prepared again.
A server limit was reached. Try later or check the project quota.
The operation could not be confirmed. Check your connection and retry. The previous result will be checked first.
This account has changed since the copy was prepared. Automatic family sync is not available yet.
Wardrobe is no longer on this device
The app will check the server. If no copy has been published, a new archive will replace the pending attempt for the same family wardrobe. Local data is retained.

Items and photos from the family server copy. Owners and editors can change name, size, location and description. Verified access lasts up to 15 minutes in this session; restarting requires a connection.
The server copy changed during download. Refresh from the server.
The server copy is not ready yet. Complete the transfer and try again.
Access needs to be checked again. Connect to the internet and refresh the copy.
Your role: owner. Item fields can be edited.
Your role: editor. Item fields can be edited.
No items to show for this search.
Refresh after signing in on a new device or after an access change. Items open from a separate server copy.
No family wardrobes yet. Create a server copy of your wardrobe or accept an invitation.
The invitation appears in the app after sign-in with this verified email address. It lasts 7 days. Tell the recipient yourself: no email is sent.
Editors can change a shared item’s name, size, location and description. Adding items, photos and shared outfit editing are upcoming steps.
Invitation accepted. The wardrobe is now available.
Revoke access for %1$s? New server requests will be denied immediately. An already downloaded copy may remain readable until its 15-minute viewing lease ends.
Leave this shared wardrobe? You will need a new invitation from its owner to return.
Accept access to “%1$s” from %2$s? Role: %3$s. The owner will see your email address.
Access or the invitation has already changed. Refresh before the next action.
The invitation expired. The owner can create a new one.
Check the address, name and role. Use an email address with ASCII characters and no spaces.
The family server does not support this action yet or is not configured. The backend needs updating.
Limit reached: up to 50 members or invitations, 50 joined wardrobes, and 30 new invitations per day. Cancel unused invitations or try later.
Could not receive confirmation or an updated list. Once connected, refresh first: the action may already have completed.
Save edits for several items, then send one at a time or the whole queue. One draft per item, up to 100 per account. Drafts are kept on this device only.
Draft saved on this device. It is not published yet.
The request is recorded. Its fields stay locked until confirmation. Retrying uses the same request without creating a duplicate.
The server wardrobe has changed. Your edit is kept locally. Review current values before sending it again.
Apply my fields to the new version
Keep your values only in the fields you changed? Other data stays as on the server. This creates a new draft; review it, then send changes.
Delete this local edit? Server data will stay unchanged.
Some changes have not been saved to the draft. Close and lose them?
No pending edit. Open an item and choose Edit fields.
This item is no longer in the server version. You can delete the local draft after a confirmed conflict.
Check the fields: name is required; limits are 120 for name, 40 for size, 200 for location and 1000 for description.

Choose a saved item from your active private wardrobe. All its fields, final photo, custom category and color are copied. Outfits, wears and purchase history are excluded. Your private item stays with you. Prepare a new item or photo in the regular editor first.
Choose an item from “%1$s” to save a copy draft.
No items found. Add an item to your private wardrobe or change the search.
The copy and photo are saved on this device, but not sent. Closing keeps the draft; one pending copy per shared wardrobe.
Send this item, its fields and photo? Members of the shared wardrobe will be able to see them.
The server confirmed the item and photo were added.
The shared wardrobe changed. Your copy is saved locally. Refresh the draft base before sending.
The request expired. Refresh the draft base and send it again.
Load the current wardrobe and add only this saved item copy? Other members’ changes stay intact. Sending still needs a separate confirmation.
Favorite: %1$s · rarely worn: %2$s · excluded from suggestions: %3$s
Please wait until the current operation finishes.
No outerwear is available for this weather, so looks are suggested without it. Add a jacket or coat to include it.
The server copy is a snapshot from the transfer. Members do not see later changes yet: updating the copy arrives with shared editing.
This item is already in saved looks, and the new category would make them impossible (for example two tops, or a dress with trousers). Change or remove it in those looks first.
Replace photo of a shared item
The new photo is first saved as a draft on this device and is sent only after a separate confirmation. Other items and photos of the shared wardrobe stay unchanged.
A gallery or camera photo is added as is, without background removal. To send a processed photo, save it in your own item first and choose “Photo from my item”.
Choose one of your items: its final photo is used. The item itself does not change.
The new photo is saved on this device and has not been sent yet. Closing keeps the draft; one unfinished photo replacement per shared wardrobe.
There is already an unfinished photo replacement for “%1$s”. Send or delete it to start another one.
Replace photo in the shared wardrobe
Replace this item’s photo for all members? The old photo leaves the shared copy if nothing else uses it.
The server confirmed the new photo.
The shared wardrobe has changed. The new photo is kept locally. Update the draft base and send it again.
Download the current wardrobe and apply the same new photo to it? Sending is a separate step.

Fill in the fields and pick a gallery photo or take one with the camera. The photo is added as is, without background removal. The item is prepared as a draft for the shared wardrobe and is not added to your private wardrobe.
Enter a name first (up to 120 characters), then choose a photo.
The outfit is saved to the shared wardrobe after you confirm sending.
One outfit draft per shared wardrobe. An unfinished draft opens first. Saving prepares changes for sending.
Save this outfit to the shared wardrobe? Its members will see the changes.
